title: Keep adequate accounting records
summary: Every company must keep records that explain its transactions and allow its financial position to be determined with reasonable accuracy.
deadline_rule: Keep records current and preserve them for the period CAMA requires.
consequence: Failing to keep adequate accounting records is an offence under CAMA that can expose the company's officers to penalties.
requirements: Record money received and spent, including the reason for each receipt or payment.
Record the company's assets and liabilities.
Keep the records at the registered office or another permitted place in Nigeria.
Preserve the records for the period required by CAMA.
